content.title: Delhi High Court Stays Lokpal Proceedings Against Defence Secretary
content.caption: The Delhi High Court has stayed proceedings before the Lokpal against Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh due to a corruption complaint.

slides.heading: Delhi High Court Stays Lokpal Proceedings Against Defence Secretary
slides.text: The Delhi High Court has stayed proceedings before the Lokpal against Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh due to a corruption complaint.

slides.heading: Background
slides.text: A petition has been filed against Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh due to allegations of irregularities and corruption in recruitment and promotions at the National Productivity Council.
slides.image_search_query: National Productivity Council, corruption, irregularities India

slides.heading: Reason for Stay
slides.text: The High Court has stayed proceedings due to a corruption complaint, as the Lokpal's orders and notices are founded on earlier judgments that have been quashed.
